cases.case_label: BRCA2 c.156_157insAlu in exon 3 causing exon 3 skipping (Portuguese founder)
cases.mechanism_detail: An Alu insertion in BRCA2 exon 3 causes skipping of exon 3; in carriers the full-length BRCA2 transcript derives only from the wild-type allele. The rearrangement was absent from 262 control chromosomes and co-segregated with disease in 14 families, with haplotype sharing consistent with a founder event.
cases.quote: This mutation originates BRCA2 exon 3 skipping and we demonstrated its pathogenic effect by showing that the BRCA2 full length transcript is derived only from the wild type allele in carriers
